title: GreenJobs client-facing measures (GET /api/stats?site=ie|uk)
description: Written by ops/metrics.py as measures_<site>.json; served unchanged by GET /api/stats?site=. Read by the board's dashboard (src/templates/dashboard.html, 'Measures to come') and by ops/keith_weekly.py. A null value means not measured yet and renders as 'coming'; a number is always computed from a real source, never estimated.

as_of.description: UTC time the measures were computed

live_jobs.description: Jobs with status live on this board now (D1 jobs).

jobs_posted_30d.description: Jobs posted in the last 30 days through the console or the Gaia feed (imports excluded).

applications_7d.description: Apply submissions on this board in the last 7 days (D1 applications, source apply).

applications_30d.description: Apply submissions on this board in the last 30 days.

applications_per_job_30d.description: applications_30d divided by live_jobs, 2 decimals; null when either is null or live_jobs is 0.

alerts_sent_7d.description: Job-alert emails sent in the last 7 days (alert send log).

alerts_opened_7d.description: Of those, the ones opened (provider open events).

live_duplicates.description: Extra live copies of a job with the same employer and title on this board; target 0.

expired_still_showing.description: Live jobs whose closing date has passed; target 0.

staff_minutes_month.description: Staff minutes this calendar month from the monthly check-in; the whole operation, so both boards carry the same value.
